title: Verify OrderItem View loads successfully with valid work request and step number
description: Ensure that the OrderItem View action returns the correct partial view with populated model data when provided with valid work request ID and step number.
preconditions: User is logged in with Orders access permissions
At least one work request exists in a checklist step stage

manual_steps.action: Navigate to a work request that is currently at a checklist step
manual_steps.expected_result: Work request detail page loads successfully

manual_steps.action: Click on the Checklist tab or step
manual_steps.expected_result: Checklist step view loads showing questions, assignee dropdown, and action buttons based on permissions

manual_steps.action: Verify the 'Assigned To' dropdown is populated
manual_steps.expected_result: Dropdown shows 'Select Assigned To' as first option followed by eligible assignees

review_note: UI element names and exact dropdown behavior assumed from controller logic. Actual field labels need verification.

title: Verify OrderItem Save operation validates required questions correctly
description: Ensure that the OrderItem Save action properly validates mandatory questions and returns QuestionsSuccess=true only when all required fields are completed.
preconditions: User is logged in with Checklist_Add_Item permission
Work request exists at checklist step with mandatory questions

manual_steps.action: Fill out all mandatory questions in the checklist form
manual_steps.expected_result: All required fields are populated with valid data

manual_steps.action: Click the Save button to submit the checklist step
manual_steps.expected_result: Form submits successfully with HTTP 200 response

manual_steps.action: Verify the response body contains QuestionsSuccess=true
manual_steps.expected_result: Response JSON shows QuestionsSuccess field is true, indicating successful validation

title: Verify OrderItem Save returns QuestionsSuccess=false when mandatory questions are incomplete
description: Ensure that the OrderItem Save action returns QuestionsSuccess=false when required questions are left empty, even though HTTP status is 200.
preconditions: User is logged in with Checklist_Add_Item permission
Work request exists at checklist step with mandatory questions

manual_steps.action: Leave one or more mandatory questions empty
Click the Save button to submit the incomplete checklist
manual_steps.expected_result: Form submits with HTTP 200 response (silent failure pattern)

manual_steps.action: Check the response body for QuestionsSuccess field
manual_steps.expected_result: Response JSON shows QuestionsSuccess=false, indicating validation failure despite HTTP 200

title: Verify unauthorized user cannot access OrderItem Save functionality
description: Ensure that users without Checklist_Add_Item permission cannot save checklist steps, even with valid data.
preconditions: User is logged in but does NOT have Checklist_Add_Item permission
Work request exists at checklist step
User can view the checklist step but should not be able to save

manual_steps.action: Navigate to a checklist step as an unauthorized user
manual_steps.expected_result: Checklist view loads but save functionality is restricted

manual_steps.action: Attempt to submit the checklist step form directly
manual_steps.expected_result: Request is rejected with appropriate authorization error

manual_steps.action: Verify no data was saved to the database
manual_steps.expected_result: Checklist step remains unchanged, no unauthorized modifications persist

review_note: Exact error message format and permission enforcement behavior needs verification from actual implementation.
